argument: Exhaustive subset-sum groups from actual bins, including empty subsets. Hall conditions on the three bin-choice sets prove distinct representatives exist or exclude the shape. For each remaining capacity-feasible shape, old remainders majorize new remainders. Concavity of r^(1-b) for all 0<b<1 implies the paid moment cannot decrease. Positive child count also cannot decrease, so the retained per-child fallback cost cannot improve.
scope: Fixed-map cyclic transfers of one whole-helper subset from each of three distinct bins to the next. Does not cover splitting one subset among two destinations, neutral preparatory moves, longer cycles, changed order/local word/stock/geometry. Not a global packing optimum.
